tool_args.rationale: The pilot rows show positive gain only at short horizons, while the verified candidate mechanism predicts a sign reversal around H=15–25. A slow-horizon discriminating probe is needed before fitting and confirming a forecast at H=24.6.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential reversal law from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed horizons are at most 0.48, so the slow-horizon behavior and reversal are not identified at the target horizon near 24.6.
Additional short-horizon detail would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to the stated mechanism and adds cost.
